feat: validate bazaar config on server startup

fix: decode X-PAYMENT header before sending to facilitator /settle

The settlePayment function was sending the raw base64 X-PAYMENT header
string to the facilitator, but the /settle endpoint expects a decoded
JSON object (matching the x402 SDK's HTTPFacilitatorClient.settle()
format). Also adds the required top-level x402Version field.

Before: { paymentPayload: 'eyJ4NDAy...' (base64 string) }
After:  { x402Version: 1, paymentPayload: { x402Version: 1, scheme: 'exact', ... } }

Added server-side error logging for settlement failures to aid debugging.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
Fix: [BOUNTY] 🔴 Red Team: x402 Payment Protocol Exploits (100 RTC) (fixes #66)
Add Postman collection for RustChain API
fmt plus expire payments
agentic-endgame

fix: x402 payment flow — custom RPC, dynamic system prompt, debug logging

Three issues fixed:

1. x402 SDK used default public mainnet RPC (heavily rate-limited).
   Now forwards SOLANA_RPC_URL to the ExactSvmScheme/ExactSvmSchemeV1
   constructors via manual registration instead of registerExactSvmScheme.

2. System prompt mentioned tools (send_usdc, get_usdc_balance) even when
   only analyze_token was available via remote MCP. Gemini hallucinated
   send_usdc calls to manually pay for the analysis. Now the prompt is
   built dynamically from actual available tools and explicitly instructs
   the model to never send USDC manually for tool payments.

3. No debug logging in x402 payment flow made failures invisible.
   Added logging at every stage: requirements parsing, payment creation,
   and paid client fallback. Run with --verbose to see full x402 flow.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
feat: production-ready dual-process startup — full agent + web server

fix: use v1 legacy network names in x402 payment requirements

The server was sending x402Version: 1 with CAIP-2 network identifiers
(e.g. 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp'). The x402 client SDK's
v1 scheme registrations only match legacy names ('solana', 'solana-devnet'),
causing 'No supported payment requirements found' errors. The payment
failure leaked to Gemini, which then tried manual USDC transfers via
send_usdc instead of using the x402 protocol.

Now the payment requirements use v1 legacy names for the network field
while still using CAIP-2 for facilitator API calls (feePayer fetch).

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
chore: bump SDKs to v1.0.0 for release
refactor(node): extract types into submodules
fix: security hardening and web discovery endpoints

fix: use CAIP-2 network identifiers for x402 payment requirements

The x402 facilitator uses CAIP-2 chain IDs (e.g. solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp
for mainnet). Map SERVER_SOLANA_NETWORK to the correct CAIP-2 ID so that
the payment requirements contain the canonical network identifier that
the x402 SDK and facilitator understand.

Accepts both legacy names (solana, solana-devnet) and CAIP-2 IDs directly.
